questions.q: Two angles are complementary. If the measure of one angle is $14^\circ$ more than three times the other, what is the measure of the smaller angle?
questions.answer: Let the smaller angle be $x$. Complementary condition: $x + (3x + 14) = 90 \Rightarrow 4x + 14 = 90 \Rightarrow 4x = 76 \Rightarrow x = 19^\circ$.

questions.q: What is the sum of the interior angle measures of a convex hexagon?
In $\triangle ABC$, the exterior angle at vertex $C$ measures $125^\circ$. If one remote interior angle measures $55^\circ$, what is the measure of the other remote interior angle?
questions.answer: Exterior angle theorem: exterior angle equals the sum of two remote interior angles: $55^\circ + x = 125^\circ \Rightarrow x = 70^\circ$.

sections.heading: Section 2: Triangles, Similarity & Special Right Triangles

questions.q: In a right triangle, the legs have lengths $9$ and $12$. What is the altitude drawn to the hypotenuse?
In an isosceles right triangle ($45^\circ$-$45^\circ$-$90^\circ$), the hypotenuse is $14\sqrt{2}$ cm. What is the perimeter of the triangle?
questions.answer: Each leg is $\frac{14\sqrt{2}}{\sqrt{2}} = 14$ cm. Perimeter $= 14 + 14 + 14\sqrt{2} = 28 + 14\sqrt{2}$ cm.

questions.q: Two similar triangles have perimeters of $24$ cm and $36$ cm. If the area of the smaller triangle is $32$ cm$^2$, what is the area of the larger triangle?
questions.answer: Scale factor of sides $= \frac{36}{24} = \frac{3}{2}$. Ratio of areas $= (\frac{3}{2})^2 = \frac{9}{4}$. Larger area $= 32 \times \frac{9}{4} = 72$ cm$^2$.

questions.q: A chord of length $16$ cm is at a distance of $6$ cm from the center of a circle. What is the radius of the circle?
questions.answer: The perpendicular from center bisects the chord into halves of $8$ cm each. Using Pythagorean theorem: $r = \sqrt{6^2 + 8^2} = \sqrt{36 + 64} = \sqrt{100} = 10$ cm.

A rectangular water tank is $4$ meters long, $3$ meters wide, and $2$ meters deep. If it is currently filled to $75\%$ of its capacity, how many cubic meters of water are in the tank?
questions.answer: Total capacity $= 4 \times 3 \times 2 = 24$ m$^3$. Filled to $75\%$: $0.75 \times 24 = 18$ m$^3$.
